topic: Is Selenic free to use as the product name of a Windows desktop AI coding assistant (formerly MoonAliza/Moonzila): software products and companies named Selenic; Selenic open-source projects and package names and web domains; Selenic registered trademarks in software and developer tools
notes: Run 1: 17 owning pages named directly, no queries (maxScrapes 17, about 17 credits). Project budget 30 credits including phase 0; phase 0 decompose spent 6 (3 searches, 388 -> 382), so 24 remain and run 1 leaves about 7 for one follow-up run. URL provenance: the Parasoft product page and selenicsystems.com/about came from the phase-0 map; the USPTO serial 88472833, the Mercurial PKG-INFO revision and the mpm wiki page, and the dictionary.com entry were located with a planning web search on 2026-10-12, which is a lead and not evidence; the RDAP servers come from the IANA RDAP bootstrap file (data.iana.org/rdap/dns.json), read during planning. Absence is collected from pages that answer 200 (registry search endpoints), because the kit keeps no capture of a 404 page; an RDAP 404 for an unregistered domain is recorded only as a ledger fail entry.
